The '''Sector Performing Arts Center''', known as '''SecPAC''', was a building constructed during the times of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], located in the [[Rayter sector/Legends|Rayter sector]]. [[Yearo Seville]] [[Operation 45RA|kidnapped]] [[Crying Dawn Singer]] when the [[Shashay]] arrived at the building.<ref name="Abduction">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>
